## What Changed

Describe the user-facing behavior and why this is the smallest correct change.

## Visual Evidence

Attach before/after screenshots or a short clip for renderer, style, layout, typography, or motion changes.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run check:browser` when rendered behavior changed
- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Desktop and phone layouts inspected
- [ ] Reduced motion considered
- [ ] New media/fonts include redistribution rights and attribution
- [ ] No secrets, `node_modules`, or temporary check artifacts committed

## Notes

List any check that could not be run and explain why.
